title: Canary de cold-start/cache del Whisper STT en navegador
mission: Run the deployed /pages/voice/ STT surface in a representative JavaScript browser with network access and characterize first-load versus cached-load behavior of the JSDelivr @huggingface/transformers dependency and Xenova/whisper-small WASM/q8 model. Record only timings/status/error classes with synthetic or non-private audio; do not store speech content.
definition_of_done: Representative browser confirms the deployed page and worker execute, or records the exact browser/network boundary before origin execution.
Cold first load and cached repeat load each have a bounded timing/status receipt through model-ready/transcription completion or exact failure.
External CDN/model dependency behavior is explicit, including whether a previously warmed cache permits repeat use; no unsupported offline-first claim is made.
No private speech/transcript, credential, Current/Human Accepted/Served, Catalog, production /w, or irreversible authority boundary is changed.
